Title: More Than Half Of Adults Over 55 Deal With Nocturia - Here's Why

Description:
Waking up to pee two or more times a night? That's nocturia, and it's far more common than people think - an enlarged prostate isn't the only cause. Alcohol and caffeine in the evening, taking blood pressure or diuretic medication close to bedtime, and untreated sleep apnea are common triggers most people miss.

Cutting alcohol and caffeine 2-3 hours before bed, asking your doctor about an earlier medication dose, and getting checked for sleep apnea can all help.
